technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt standard Spring Cloud Stream starter repository architecture and module structure for all migrated components.
Refactor legacy Spring XD XML configuration and module definitions into Spring Boot auto-configurations and Spring Cloud Stream functional components or `@EnableBinding` definitions.
Use Spring Integration components (e.g., Spring Integration MQTT, TCP, JDBC, Aggregator) under the hood for message processing.
Implement automated integration tests for each module using embedded servers, Testcontainers, or standard mock implementations where appropriate.
assumptions: Source code and configuration files for the legacy Spring XD modules (mqtt, null, shell, splunk, tcp, jdbc, aggregator, http-client) are accessible.
Target repository (s-c-s / Spring Cloud Stream app starters) structure and CI/CD pipelines are available.
All dependencies and target Java/Spring Boot framework versions align with the standard Spring Cloud Stream repository conventions.
Documentation for configuration properties will be generated using standard Spring Boot metadata tooling.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing Spring XD modules, define common module structures, setup build scripts (Gradle/Maven), and configure base dependencies for Spring Cloud Stream apps.
Migrate the mqtt sink module from Spring XD to s-c-s, implementing configuration properties, outbound channel adapter setup, and unit/integration tests with an embedded MQTT broker.
Migrate the simple null sink module to s-c-s to discard messages efficiently, including test coverage.
Migrate the shell sink module to execute system commands/scripts on payload receipt, adding property bindings and integration tests.
Migrate the splunk sink module to write event payloads to Splunk, including authentication/endpoint configuration properties and unit tests.
Migrate the tcp sink module for outbound TCP network communication, including connection pooling, encoders/serializers configuration, and integration tests.
Migrate the jdbc source module to poll database tables and output stream messages, including datasource configuration, SQL query mapping, and H2 integration tests.
Port the aggregator processor module from XD to s-c-s, implementing payload/header aggregation logic, message store configuration, release strategies, and tests.
Port the http-client processor module to handle request-reply REST/HTTP invocations within a stream pipeline, configuring URI templates, request headers, and tests.
Perform end-to-end verification across migrated modules, update documentation and README files for target modules, and ensure CI pipeline builds successfully.
